args.title: Halvorsen Supply Newsletter Summary – Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter headline: "Freight pricing this quarter" — spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now adjust weekly based on diesel prices.
- Linked article (blog.halvorsen.example/2026/freight): Expands on the same freight pricing trends — softening spot market vs. stable contract rates, with surcharge mechanics tied to weekly diesel benchmarks.
- Companion piece (insights.halvorsen.example/freight/companion): Finds that shippers who split volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs this quarter.
